name: Remote Heartbeat Detection (rPPG)
description: Detects physiological heartbeat signals from facial video to verify human presence.
useCase: Verifying real human presence in video through remote photoplethysmography analysis
mechanism: Extracts subtle color changes in facial skin caused by blood circulation (rPPG signal) and analyzes its temporal characteristics. Real faces exhibit periodic color fluctuations corresponding to heartbeat. AI-generated faces lack these physiological signals or produce incoherent patterns.
source: Ciftci, U. et al. (2020) - FakeCatcher: Detection of Synthetic Portrait Videos using Biological Signals, IEEE TPAMI
algorithm: rPPG Signal Extraction (CHROM/POS) + Power Spectrum Analysis + Physiological Plausibility Check
parameters: ROI: forehead + cheeks, Sampling: 30fps minimum, Window: 10 seconds, Frequency range: 0.7-4.0 Hz
strengths:
• Based on actual physiological signals
• Very hard for current AI to simulate
• Non-intrusive and automatic
• Strong theoretical foundation in biomedical engineering
limitations:
• Requires stable video at sufficient fps
• Makeup can attenuate signal
• Motion artifacts reduce accuracy
• Low lighting conditions degrade performance

references.title: Ciftci, U. et al. (2020). FakeCatcher: Detection of Synthetic Portrait Videos using Biological Signals. IEEE TPAMI.
Qi, H. et al. (2020). DeepRhythm: Exposing DeepFakes with Attentional Visual Heartbeat Rhythms. ACM MM.
Hernandez-Ortega, J. et al. (2020). DeepFakesON-Phys: DeepFakes Detection based on Heart Rate Estimation. AAAI Workshop.
